name: Drum Fel
summary: At Hammerfall, Drum Fel directs the Horde’s fight to hold Arathi against trolls, ogres, and human remnants. With his wife Korin, he seeks a lasting foothold for the Horde in the region.

sections.title: Warden of Hammerfall
sections.body: Drum Fel commands Hammerfall’s defenses and leads the Horde’s push into Arathi. From this fortified refuge, he faces rival factions on every side. The Witherbark forest trolls and Boulderfist ogres hold Boulder'gor and Boulderfist Hall. Drum knows Hammerfall cannot thrive in isolation, so their strength must be broken. He sends veteran champions into hostile territory to disrupt these threats before they can strike the encampment.

sections.title: The Threat in Stromgarde
sections.body: Drum Fel carries his campaign into Stromgarde Keep, where Boulderfist ogres hold among the ruins of the fallen human kingdom. Years ago, Drum defeated the ogre brute Or'Kalar, who has not forgotten the defeat. Now Or'Kalar waits inside Stromgarde, seeking vengeance. Korin, Drum’s wife, quietly hides his presence from her husband. She relies on outside adventurers to remove the threat before Drum charges into an ambush.

faq.answer: Drum Fel leads the Horde’s military effort from Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. He directs campaigns against rival factions in the region.

faq.q: Where can Drum Fel be found?
faq.answer: Drum Fel can be found inside Hammerfall, in northeastern Arathi Highlands, just east of the main road north into the Hinterlands.
Korin Fel is Drum Fel’s wife, and she lives in Hammerfall.

faq.q: Why does the ogre Or'Kalar want Drum Fel dead?
aliases: why does orkalar hate drum fel
faq.answer: Years ago, Drum Fel defeated Or'Kalar in battle. The humiliated ogre now waits in the ruins of Stromgarde Keep, seeking vengeance against Drum.

faq.q: What threats does Drum Fel target?
faq.answer: Drum Fel directs strikes against the Boulderfist ogres at Boulder'gor, Boulderfist Hall, and Stromgarde Keep. He also targets the nearby Witherbark troll tribe.

angles.text: For Horde warriors advancing through the Eastern Kingdoms, Drum Fel coordinates the effort to secure the fragile lifeline between the Undercity and the southern territories.
As an orc, Drum Fel shows the hard resolve needed to rebuild orcish lives in the Eastern Kingdoms. He holds ground in the land where the internment camps once stood.
